children: Brazil's central bank said on Thursday it expects annual inflation to reach 3.1% in the second quarter of 2028, the 18-month horizon relevant to its next monetary policy decision in November.

In its quarterly monetary policy report, the bank forecast annual inflation would stay at 3.1% through the first quarter of 2029, the furthest horizon covered by its projections. The official target is 3%.
The central bank also lowered its 2026 economic growth forecast to 1.8% from 2.0% previously, and for the first time projected gross domestic product (GDP) growth of 1.4% in 2027.
